title: Obfuscated blockchain-C2 remote-code loader hidden in postcss.config.js (repository compromise)
repro: Static: 1/1; runtime load attempted once (parse failed)
expected: Config contains only tailwind/autoprefixer plugin map (clean version at a77912a). Authority: repository history; any executable code in a build config is unacceptable.
actual: Hidden function GSkqNNyuJw$_padNcYwam queries Ethereum address 0xa322E5f3D311D3080e6f0121063e9aDC2490Ef1a via public RPCs, fetches a compressed next stage and executes it with child_process/require. Introduced by commit 1378776 (author jhanjay09, 2026-08-04) together with .gitignore entries temp_auto_push.bat/temp_interactive_push.bat.
impact: Any machine or CI/Amplify builder that loads the config may execute attacker code: credential theft (GitHub, AWS/Amplify, DB, API keys), further repo tampering.
cause: CONFIRMED malicious insertion; compromised contributor workstation = hypothesis
fix: Restore clean config, block merges, rotate all reachable secrets, investigate jhanjay09 account/workstation and Amplify build logs since 2026-08-04, add CI hidden-payload/line-length guard.
accept: git grep GSkqNNyuJw returns nothing on all branches; CI guard fails on lines >2,000 chars in config files; secrets rotated.

title: Estimate roll-up 'appliedTotals.grandTotal' ignores per-line overhead/profit allocations (shows $623,942.68 vs priced $782,052.11)

On screen (evidence/screenshots/desktop-bid-estimate-estimator.png) the estimator sees three figures at once: 'Total Estimate $782,052.11', 'Org Markup Breakdown — Grand Total $623,942.68', and 'Profit Margin $102,950.54 (15% of cost + overhead)' — none of which is the estimate's actual profit of $158,109.43. accept: grandTotal = Σ totalCost when org factors are zero.
